note: BH-5795: the longest a head waits in the traced hold. After it the lead review is requested anyway and its scope note says `tests did not run: <reason>`, so no PR stalls on a run that never comes. It protects the review from running before the dispatched impact run (a few minutes). Each firing costs one review on a head with no test evidence, said in the note. 0 = off: no hold, the head is requested at once with the note. Moved from the retired lead-review-enqueue lane (BH-5878): the worklist gates read it.
